prompt: A bootleg convoy on a wet highway at night, 1920s America, a 16:9 picture filling the frame edge to edge. An 85mm lens looks from outside a moving sedan into the open front passenger window. Close and large in frame sits a clean-shaven man of about seventy-five, long-jawed and heavy-lidded, in a bowler hat and three-piece suit, near-frontal, mouth open mid-word, a double-barrelled shotgun upright against his far shoulder, away from his face. Ruby tail lamps of the truck ahead paint his cheek and lips. Beside his head, a round chrome mirror on the door holds the whole convoy curving away behind: lemon-yellow headlamps in a long line, shining on black road. Rain beads on the door glass and the black beyond is total. Thanks.
